383-she-stoops-to-conquer-or-the-mistake.title: She Stoops To Conquer Or The Mistakes Of A Night A Comedy
383-she-stoops-to-conquer-or-the-mistake.creator: Oliver Goldsmith
383-she-stoops-to-conquer-or-the-mistake.description: A book by Oliver Goldsmith. Both nervous grown, to keep our spirits up. We now and then take down a hearty cup. If Comedy forsake us, They’ll turn us out, and no one else will take us. But why can’t I be moral?

arxiv-2003-08541.title: Meteorology and Oceanography on a Flat Earth
arxiv-2003-08541.creator: John P. Boyd
arxiv-2003-08541.description: Abstract To build insight into the atmosphere and ocean, it is useful to apply qualitative reasoning to predict the geophysical fluid dynamics of worlds radically different from our own such as exoplanets, earth in Nuclear Winter, other solar system worlds, and far future terrestial climates.

arxiv-2006-13733.title: Operational Research Literature as a Use Case for the Open Research Knowledge Graph
arxiv-2006-13733.creator: Mila Runnwerth, Markus Stocker, Sören Auer
arxiv-2006-13733.description: Abstract The Open Research Knowledge Graph (ORKG) provides machine-actionable access to scholarly literature that habitually is written in prose. Following the FAIR principles, the ORKG makes traditional, human-coded knowledge findable, accessible, interoperable, and reusable in a structured manner in accordance with the Linked Open Data paradigm.

arxiv-2011-08801.title: Imaging Using Millimeter Wave Communication Networks: A Bonus SAR
arxiv-2011-08801.creator: Husheng Li
arxiv-2011-08801.description: Abstract In the next generations of cellular communication networks, higher density of base stations and higher frequency bands will be adopted. If being reflected by targets, the communication signal also brings information of the targets, in addition to the communication messages, to the receivers.

arxiv-2206-00025.title: Testing White Dwarf Age Estimates using Wide Double White Dwarf Binaries from Gaia EDR3
arxiv-2206-00025.creator: Tyler M. Heintz, J. J. Hermes, Kareem El-Badry, Charlie Walsh, Jennifer L. van Saders, C. E. Fields, Detlev Koester
arxiv-2206-00025.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Tyler M. Heintz, J. J. Hermes, Kareem El-Badry, Charlie Walsh, Jennifer L. van Saders, C. E. Fields, Detlev Koester. White dwarf (WD) stars evolve simply and predictably, making them reliable age indicators. However, self-consistent validation of the methods for determining WD total ages has yet to be widely performed. This work uses 1565 wide ( > 100 >100 au) WD+WD binaries and 24 new triples containing at least two WDs to test the accuracy and validity of WD total age determinations.

arxiv-2305-13760.title: Systematics of yields of strange hadrons from heavy-ion collisions around threshold energies
arxiv-2305-13760.creator: K. Piasecki, P. Piotrowski
arxiv-2305-13760.description: Abstract The parametrizations of experimental yields of K ±,0 , ϕ \phi and Λ + Σ 0 \Lambda+\Sigma^{0} are proposed as function of available energy, s NN \sqrt{s_{\mathrm{NN}}} , and number of participants, ⟨ A part ⟩ b \langle A_{\mathrm{part}}\rangle_{\mathrm{b}} , for s NN \sqrt{s_{\mathrm{NN}}} from 2.15 to 3 GeV.

arxiv-2309-06407.title: Self-Similar Outflows at the Source of the Fast Solar Wind: A Smoking Gun of Multiscale Impulsive Reconnection?
arxiv-2309-06407.creator: Vadim M. Uritsky, Judith T. Karpen, Nour E. Raouafi, Pankaj Kumar, C. Richard DeVore, Craig E. Deforest
arxiv-2309-06407.description: Abstract We present results of a quantitative analysis of structured plasma outflows above a polar coronal hole observed by the Atmospheric Imaging Assembly onboard the Solar Dynamics Observatory spacecraft. In a 6-hour interval of continuous high-cadence SDO/AIA images, we identified more than 2300 episodes of small-scale plasma flows in the polar corona.

arxiv-2312-10088.title: On Robustness to Missing Video for Audiovisual Speech Recognition
arxiv-2312-10088.creator: Oscar Chang oscarchang@google.com, Otavio Braga obraga@google.com, Hank Liao hankliao@google.com, Dmitriy Serdyuk dserdyuk@google.com, Olivier Siohan siohan@google.com
arxiv-2312-10088.description: Abstract It has been shown that learning audiovisual features can lead to improved speech recognition performance over audio-only features, especially for noisy speech. However, in many common applications, the visual features are partially or entirely missing, e.g. the speaker might move off screen.

arxiv-2501-04102.title: Enhancing Distribution and Label Consistency for Graph Out-of-Distribution Generalization
arxiv-2501-04102.creator: Song Wang 2 , Xiaodong Yang 3 , Rashidul Islam 3 , Huiyuan Chen 3 , Minghua Xu 3 , Jundong Li 2 , Yiwei Cai 3
arxiv-2501-04102.description: Abstract To deal with distribution shifts in graph data, various graph out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization techniques have been recently proposed. These methods often employ a two-step strategy that first creates augmented environments and subsequently identifies invariant subgraphs to improve generalizability. Nevertheless, this approach could be suboptimal from the perspective of consistency .

arxiv-2507-02061.title: New algorithms for girth and cycle detection
arxiv-2507-02061.creator: Liam Roditty, Plia Trabelsi
arxiv-2507-02061.description: Abstract Let G = ( V , E ) G=(V,E) be an unweighted undirected graph with n n vertices and m m edges. Let g g be the girth of G G , that is, the length of a shortest cycle in G G .

arxiv-2507-19146.title: Diverse and Adaptive Behavior Curriculum for Autonomous Driving: A Student-Teacher Framework with Multi-Agent RL
arxiv-2507-19146.creator: Ahmed Abouelazm, Johannes Ratz, Philip Schoerner, J. Marius Zöllner
arxiv-2507-19146.description: Abstract Autonomous driving faces challenges in navigating complex real-world traffic, requiring safe handling of both common and critical scenarios. Reinforcement learning (RL), a prominent method in end-to-end driving, enables agents to learn through trial and error in simulation. However, RL training often relies on rule-based traffic scenarios, limiting generalization.

pmc-10518922.title: Supraclavicular nerve sparing versus sacrifice during open reduction internal fixation of acute midshaft clavicle fracture
pmc-10518922.creator: Ruei Hu, Yu-Jung Su, Chi-Sheng Chien
pmc-10518922.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundThe branches of the supraclavicular nerve are often sacrificed during open reduction and internal fixation (ORIF) for clavicle fracture. No consensus exists on whether the supraclavicular nerve should be routinely identified and protected during ORIF.MethodsWe developed a simple method to make nerve sparing easier; Wide-Awake Local Anesthesia No Tourniquet (WALANT) solution is locally injected prior to the surgical incision being made. This retrospective study enrolled 340 patients and divided them into supraclavicular-nerve-sparing (n = 45) and supraclavicular-nerve-sacrifice (n = 295) groups.

pmc-11467838.title: Strong Magnetic Exchange Interactions and Delocalized Mn–O States Enable High-Voltage Capacity in the Na-Ion Cathode P2–Na0.67[Mg0.28Mn0.72]O2
pmc-11467838.creator: Euan N Bassey, Howie Nguyen, Teresa Insinna, Jeongjae Lee, Anne-Laure Barra, Giannantonio Cibin, Peter Bencok, Raphaële
pmc-11467838.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The increased capacity offered by oxygen-redox active cathode materials for rechargeable lithium- and sodium-ion batteries (LIBs and NIBs, respectively) offers a pathway to the next generation of high-gravimetric-capacity cathodes for use in devices, transportation and on the grid. Many of these materials, however, are plagued with voltage fade, voltage hysteresis and O2 loss, the origins of which can be traced back to changes in their electronic and chemical structures on cycling.

pmc-12534492.title: Decoding adult murine pancreatic islet cell diversity through cell type-resolved proteomics and phosphoproteomics
pmc-12534492.creator: Marvin Thielert, Adrian Villalba, Vincenth Brennsteiner, Maria Wahle, Constantin Ammar, Andreas-David Brunner, Alexis Fouque, Chloé Lourenço, Masaya Oshima, Latif Rachdi, Willem Staels, Matthias Mann, Raphaël Scharfmann
pmc-12534492.description: Islets of Langerhans are micro-organs scattered throughout the pancreas. They are composed of insulin-producing beta cells, glucagon-producing alpha cells, and somatostatin-producing delta cells. While their transcriptome has been extensively analyzed, protein-level information remains limited due to cell scarcity and purification challenges.

pmc-13051253.title: Analysis of Nematode Ventral Nerve Cords Suggests Multiple Instances of Evolutionary Changes to Neuron Number
pmc-13051253.creator: Jaeyeong Han, Alyson Ficca, Marissa Lanzatella, Kanika Leang, Matthew Barnum, Jonathan C. T. Boudreaux, Nathan E. Schroeder
pmc-13051253.description: Despite their diversity in habitats, nematodes are often considered to have a highly conserved neuroanatomy. This premise is based on only a subset of the nematode phylogenetic tree within the subclass Chromadoria, which includes the model organism Caenorhabditis elegans, thereby limiting our understanding of macroevolutionary trends in nervous system structure.

pmc-13237303.title: An interpretable ultrasound-based deep learning system for early breast cancer in a Chinese population
pmc-13237303.creator: Siqi Wu, Shenwen Wang, Di Liang, Jin Shi, Xiao Shang, Liwen Zhang, Yanyu Liu, Xin Su, Yi Wang, Qian Lu, Zheng Li, Zhenfeng Zhao, Xiaohui Ji, Daojuan Li, Yutong He
pmc-13237303.description: ObjectivesCurrent deep learning models for early breast cancer lack interpretability and multimodal integration, limiting their clinical acceptance. This study aimed to develop and evaluate a deep learning system that automates breast ultrasound evaluation to support early breast cancer detection in clinical assessment.

pmc-13689904.creator: Alice Cartoceti, Simona Achilli, Masoumeh Alihosseini, Adriana E. Candia, Enrico Beltrami, Paolo D'Agosta, Alessio Orbelli Biroli, Francesco Sedona, Andrea Li Bassi, Jorge Lobo‐Checa, Carlo S. Casari
pmc-13689904.description: Two‐dimensional heterostructures combining sp–sp hybridization—blending graphene with graphyne‐based allotropes—offer substantial potential for enhancing the tunability of electronic and transport properties while providing significant structural flexibility, which are desirable characteristics for next‐generation nanoscale electronics. Despite such potential, their experimental realization remains elusive, as synthesized carbon heterostructures are limited to doped, graphene‐based systems exhibiting exclusively sp hybridization.
